name: scikit-learn
methods: Gap-aware chronological validation informed by TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits, max_train_size, test_size, gap), while retaining Zax's custom label-interval purging
Weighted decision-stump benchmark equivalent to DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1) with criterion gini/log_loss, min_samples_leaf, balanced class weights, and fixed random seed
Out-of-fold sigmoid/Platt probability calibration following CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid', cv=<custom purged chronological splitter>, ensemble=False)
reuseDecision: Recommend an independent TypeScript implementation of the published methods. Do not run or embed scikit-learn in Expo and do not copy source by default. BSD-3-Clause permits selective source reuse only with retained copyright, conditions, and disclaimer and without endorsement claims.
requirements: Owner-controlled, time-indexed historical feature/label data with timestamp, instrument, decision-time feature values, and forward-label end time or horizon
Existing custom purged chronological splits retained; configure and persist nSplits, testSize, maxTrainSize, and a gap at least as long as the contiguous forward-label horizon
No scikit-learn payment, GitHub account, brokerage account, provider registration, user-data upload, or runtime GitHub call is required
Paid historical market/L2 data is only a separate optional requirement if the owner's current data lacks the desired coverage or depth
If code is ever redistributed from the repository, retain the BSD 3-Clause notice and disclaimer and do not use project/contributor names for endorsement
